label: WWTR1::CAMTA1

sections.text: WWTR1 encodes TAZ, a transcriptional coactivator regulated by Hippo signaling.
CAMTA1 encodes a calmodulin-binding transcriptional regulator.

The fusion joins a Hippo-pathway transcriptional coactivator to a transcription-factor partner and creates abnormal nuclear transcriptional activity. WWTR1::CAMTA1 is the canonical molecular driver of epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.
